name: AutoECMs
old_description: Since 1994, AutoECMs has been a leading worldwide source for quality remanufactured automotive engine control modules.
about:
AutoECMs has operated from Duryea, Pennsylvania since 1994. The company was founded that year as a specialist in remanufactured automotive engine control modules, though the names of the founders and the ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business remanufactures a range of electronic control units for vehicles, including engine control modules (ECMs), body control modules (BCMs), mass air flow sensors (MAFs), anti-lock brake system modules (ABS), transmission control modules (TCMs), and generic electronic modules (GEMs). Its service includes part‑number validation to ensure correct fitment, programming support for reflashing modules, and a core‑charge program that encourages the return of used units for remanufacturing.

AutoECMs serves the automotive aftermarket worldwide, supplying repair shops, dealerships, and individual vehicle owners who need replacement electronic modules. The company describes itself as a global source for these remanufactured parts.

The company emphasizes quality remanufacturing and the convenience of part‑number validation as key reasons customers choose it, aiming to reduce the risk of ordering incorrect modules.
